flex_item_guide.title: Items explained — simple English
flex_item_guide.disclaimer: Plain-language guides for new and situational items. Not live win rates. Primary builds come from this site’s kit + patch model — not copied from other build sites.

featured.name: Barbed Carver
featured.simple: Ability hits apply Jagged Wounds (max 3). Basics and abilities deal bonus physical damage per stack (scales with your lifesteal).
featured.how: Cast to stack wounds, then auto/ability for bonus damage. Replaced Serrated Edge (old name still ghosts on trackers/wiki).
featured.when: Physical ability junglers/bruisers who also basic-attack in the combo.
featured.when_not: Pure mage INT kits; you never land abilities.
featured.buy_as: Jungle 1st–3rd on ability-physical kits. Live shop name — not Serrated Edge.

featured.name: Chandra's Grace
featured.simple: +15% heal/shield strength (OB43 hotfix). Every 15s, lowest-HP nearby ally gets regen and tiny cooldown shred.
featured.how: Aura amp for healers plus a periodic “help the dying ally” buff. Hotfix cut amp 20→15% — still fine on true healers, not a generic Solo shell.
featured.when: Support heal/amp paths after Thebes / Sickle / Asclepius.
featured.when_not: You’re full damage with no heals; non-healer Solo looking for free aura.
featured.buy_as: Support heal flex after core enchanter items. Remade OB43; hotfix 9/9.

featured.name: Daybreak Gavel
featured.simple: Heal yourself with a healing ability to build stacks; your next non-heal ability spends them for a big STR or INT buff.
featured.how: Self-heal → stacks → cast 2/3/ult to cash power. Adaptive STR/INT from your other items.
featured.when: Self-heal kits (Wild Artemis traps, some bruisers) that also cast non-heals.
featured.when_not: No self-heal; pure ally-heal support with no dump spell.
featured.buy_as: Pair with Vital Amplifier on self-heal AA paths. Remade OB43.

featured.name: Eros' Bow
featured.simple: Mark an ally as Beloved. Basic-attack to stack Devotion, then buff/heal/shield them to dump Passion (bonus STR and INT on that ally).
featured.how: Same trigger family as Sickle/Locket. Fiddly — mark, auto, then heal. Strong pocket amp if you commit.
featured.when: Enchanter supports who can AA safely next to the carry.
featured.when_not: You hate actives / never basic-attack; prefer Sickle+Locket only.
featured.buy_as: Optional 4th after Sickle/Locket — skip if too many actives. Remade OB43.

featured.name: Gem of Isolation
featured.simple: INT + HP brick that slows on ability hit. OB44 added 15 Tenacity and cut cost.
featured.how: Land abilities to keep enemies slowed while you stay harder to CC.
featured.when: Mage supports/bruisers who poke and hate getting locked down.
featured.when_not: You never land abilities; you already have Tenacity elsewhere and need shred.
featured.buy_as: Support/Solo flex for poke + anti-CC. OB44 Tenacity package.

featured.name: Heartwood Charm
featured.simple: Heal/shield bank dump active. OB45 restored real CDR (20%) and INT (45) after the OB43 hotfix cut.
featured.how: Spam heals to fill the bank → press active for a team heal bomb. Still costs an active slot — prefer Asclepius + Sickle first; Heartwood is the flex active when you want the dump.
featured.when: Healer supports who specifically want the bank dump and have an active slot free.
featured.when_not: No heal abilities; you already have Soul Locket; prefer button-light paths.
featured.buy_as: Healer flex after Sickle/Asclepius — not default dual-active. OB45 buffed stats.

featured.name: Lifebinder
featured.simple: Active marks an enemy; the first ally to damage them gets a big heal and shield (amped by your heal/shield strength).
featured.how: Mark → ally hits → heal bomb. Stronger if you already built heal amp.
featured.when: Healers who group fight and can mark the dive target.
featured.when_not: No heal identity; active slots full.

featured.name: Lotus Sickle
featured.simple: Buff, heal, or shield an ally → gain Lotus stacks. When an ally basic-attacks an enemy, a stack pops for bonus magical damage.
featured.how: You’re charging free damage onto your ADC’s autos. Needs an ally who actually basics (Carry). Same trigger as Soul Locket — they stack together. Passiveive — no button. Do not buy/sell to stack stats (exploit; suspensions).
featured.when: Healer/buff supports (Aphrodite, Yemoja, Guan, Sylvanus, Ix Chel) pocketing a crit/AS carry.
featured.when_not: No ally buffs/heals/shields in kit; team never basic-attacks.
featured.buy_as: Support 2nd after Thebes (cheap CDR + Int). Live in shop; OB45 also scales bonus dmg with 20% Attack Damage.

featured.name: Rod Of Asclepius
featured.simple: +10% heal/shield strength. When you heal an ally, you heal even more the lower their HP is.
featured.how: Missing-HP heal amp. Stacks with Soul Locket / Heartwood / Chandra amp.

featured.name: Soul Locket
featured.simple: +10% stronger heals/shields. Buff/heal/shield allies to charge Soul stacks. Active: ghost form — move speed, walk through walls/players, and damage reduction from your stacks.
featured.how: Same trigger as Lotus Sickle. Build stacks while healing, then press the active when you’re dove or need to escape. Long cooldown — treat it like a save button, not spam.
featured.when: Enchanter supports who stay in fights and get focused.
featured.when_not: You never heal/buff allies; you already have 3 better actives.
featured.buy_as: Support 2nd–3rd with Sickle. Pop when dove or escaping. New in OB43.

featured.name: Stone of Binding
featured.simple: Your hard CC shreds their physical and magical protections (stacks). OB44 raised shred from 7 to 10.
featured.how: Only works if you land hard CC (stun/root/knockup/etc.).
featured.when: You have reliable hard CC (Ymir, Atlas, Hades, etc.).
featured.when_not: Soft CC only / no CC in kit.
featured.buy_as: CC gods — synergy item, not random bulk. Stronger after OB44.

featured.name: Vital Amplifier
featured.simple: Heal yourself with an ability → stacking attack speed and basic-attack damage (up to 3 stacks).
featured.how: Self-heal ticks (e.g. Artemis Aspect of the Wild traps) can stack this fast. Adaptive STR or INT from your other items.
featured.when: Self-heal kits that also basic-attack (Wild Artemis, some bruisers).
featured.when_not: No self-heal in kit; pure ability mage who never autos.
featured.buy_as: After a STR/INT core so adaptive lands correctly. Remade OB43.

items.name: Alchemist Coat
items.simple: Using consumables gives dampening; free Multi Potion over time if you have a slot.
items.how: Potion engine + tankiness when you chug.
items.when: You buy pots and want free value.
items.when_not: Never use consumables.

items.name: Amanita Charm
items.simple: Active drops a healing mushroom zone that heals and stacks damage reduction.
items.how: Place for team heal + DR in a pit or under tower.
items.when: Teamfight support who holds ground.
items.when_not: You never group or use actives.

items.name: Bancroft's Talon
items.simple: The lower your HP, the more INT and lifesteal you get.
items.how: Comeback / low-HP fighter mage. Risky: rewards being hurt.
items.when: Aggressive LS mages who fight in the red.
items.when_not: You play full HP safe poke only (still usable, less ideal).

items.name: Bloodforge
items.simple: STR + lifesteal; active gives a big health shield that also buffs LS.
items.how: All-in vamp. Press shield when you dive.
items.when: Physical divers who auto/spell vamp.
items.when_not: Pure tank with no damage; mage INT path.

items.name: Brawler's Beat Stick
items.simple: Hitting gods applies healing reduction + you stack combat stats.
items.how: Anti-heal for bruisers/hybrids. Adaptive STR or INT from your build.
items.when: Enemy heals/lifesteals and you’re a damage or hybrid role.
items.when_not: No heals; pure tank with no damage to apply it.
items.buy_as: Solo/Jungle/Carry into sustain; sometimes Mid hybrid.

items.name: Circe's Hexstone
items.simple: Active: poly dash with CC immune and prots; hitting a god knocks up and deals % current HP.
items.how: Engage/peel dash toy. Build so you can afford the active slot.
items.when: You want a displacement engage on a tank.
items.when_not: Active slots already full of better tools.

items.name: Contagion
items.simple: Enemies who hit you or lifesteal off you get stacks. You AA or hard CC them to explode stacks for % of YOUR max HP damage.
items.how: Not real anti-heal. Soft punish freefire/LS. You must detonate with AA or hard CC.
items.when: You’re the freefire tank into LS ADC/bruisers.
items.when_not: You need antiheal (buy Stygian/Brawler’s/Divine or Sundering 40%); you’re mid glass.
items.buy_as: Tank flex; never your only anti-heal into Aphro.

items.name: Divine Ruin
items.simple: Mage anti-heal: your god damage cuts healing + lightning proc.
items.how: The mid-lane answer to Aphro/Yogi’s/sustain. Also INT power.
items.when: Any real healing on the enemy (or you’re not sure — safe default mid).
items.when_not: Full glass lobby with zero sustain and you need pure burst sooner.

items.name: Doublet of Binding
items.simple: Active links an ally: you take 20% of their damage (mitigated by your dampening).
items.how: Bodyguard button. Stack damp/prots so the redirected damage is soft.
items.when: You peel one carry hard (Athena/Geb/Ymir).
items.when_not: You’re the one dying first with no bulk.

items.name: Erosion
items.simple: Enemy shields near you are much weaker; you gain prots when that happens.
items.how: Anti-shield aura. Great into shield-heavy kits/items.
items.when: Lots of shields (Berserk shields, item shields, kit shields).
items.when_not: Nobody shields — wasted slot.

items.name: Ethereal Staff
items.simple: Ability hits steal max HP (and mana) from the target over time stacks.
items.how: You get thicker, they get thinner across the fight. Needs multiple ability hits.
items.when: Long fights vs HP stackers.
items.when_not: You cast once and die; no multi-hit kit.

items.name: Eye of Erebus
items.simple: Active drops an eye that blasts % max HP, reveals, and slows the first enemy in range.
items.how: Trap/zone tool + adaptive power. Place on chokes or objectives.
items.when: Roam/setup tanks and bruisers.
items.when_not: You never use actives or set vision traps.

items.name: Eye of Providence
items.simple: Dual prot + free sentry wards over time; gold for killing wards.
items.how: Vision item. Keeps wards in your inventory loop.
items.when: Enemy wards everything / you want free sentry uptime.
items.when_not: You already have perfect vision and need combat stats more.

items.name: Gauntlet of Thebes
items.simple: Stacks max HP from assists; fully stacked gives more HP and dual prots for the team aura fantasy.
items.how: Support farm item. Stack on minions/gods → evolve power.
items.when: Almost every Support game as core.
items.when_not: You’re not actually supporting (full damage mid).

items.name: Genji's Guard
items.simple: Big magical protection; getting hit by magic shortens your cooldowns.
items.how: Mage damage answer. They hit you with magic → you get CDs back.
items.when: Fed mid mage or magical damage everywhere.
items.when_not: All physical lobby (ADC + phys jungle only).

items.name: Gluttonous Grimoire
items.simple: Part of your lifesteal is stored as bonus damage on your next basic attack.
items.how: Cast/LS → bank → AA to dump a chunk. Stores more at full HP.
items.when: INT + lifesteal mages (Hades, Anubis-style).
items.when_not: No LS; you never basic attack.

items.name: Magi's Cloak
items.simple: Every so often, the next hard CC on you is blocked (short CC immunity).
items.how: Anti-lockdown bubble on a cooldown. Saves you from root/stun openers.
items.when: Heavy hard CC / dive (Bastet, Fenrir, Ymir lock, etc.).
items.when_not: Soft poke only, no real CC threat.
items.buy_as: Anyone getting locked before they can act.

items.name: Mantle Of Discord
items.simple: When you drop low, you stun nearby enemies and get CC immune briefly.
items.how: Panic button passive at low HP. Long cooldown.
items.when: You’re the dive target and need a last-stand peel.
items.when_not: You never drop low / never frontline.

items.name: Mantle of Discord
items.simple: When you drop low, you stun nearby enemies and get CC immune briefly.
items.how: Panic button passive at low HP. Long cooldown.
items.when: You’re the dive target and need a last-stand peel.
items.when_not: You never drop low / never frontline.

items.name: Midgardian Mail
items.simple: When they basic-attack you, their attack speed drops (stacks).
items.how: They freefire you → they get slower. You want them hitting you (frontline).
items.when: ADC or AA jungler is freefiring your face.
items.when_not: Nobody basics you (pure mage poke from range).
items.buy_as: Support/Solo tank path when AA is the problem.

items.name: Obsidian Shard
items.simple: % magical penetration + first ability cast gets bonus pen (Shattering).
items.how: Makes mage damage actually land on tanks. First cast of the cycle is juicier.
items.when: Any mid that needs to kill tanks / bulk.
items.when_not: Never finishing pen into triple tank (you’ll bounce).

items.name: Omen Drum
items.simple: Active: abilities mark enemies for 5s, then a % of the damage you dealt is echoed to all marked.
items.how: Multi-hit ability combos shine. Press before full rotation.
items.when: Ability spam kits in teamfights.
items.when_not: One-spell pokes; you forget actives.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.simple: Magic bulk + active pulses that heal you and true-damage nearby enemies.
items.how: Tank mprot item with a panic heal/true damage button.
items.when: Magic damage + you want a self-peel active.
items.when_not: You need pure aura peel and never press actives.

items.name: Prophetic Cloak
items.simple: Damaging gods stacks protections vs their damage type; evolves into stronger dual prot + mitigation.
items.how: Adaptive tank: fight people → stack the right prots → evolve.
items.when: Frontliners in long games who hit a lot of gods.
items.when_not: You need an immediate answer (Spectral/Genji’s) this fight.
items.buy_as: Early tank scaler; evolve is the payoff.

items.name: Sanguine Lash
items.simple: Nearby enemies take % HP damage over time; scales with your lifesteal. Active makes ticks faster.
items.how: Melee sit-on-them item. Build LS and stay in range.
items.when: Melee LS assassins/bruisers.
items.when_not: Ranged poke; no LS.

items.name: Shifter's Shield
items.simple: High HP: free STR or INT. Low HP: free dual protections.
items.how: Hybrid tank/damage. Healthy = offline damage; hurt = tank mode.
items.when: Solo/Support default bulk almost always.
items.when_not: Full glass ADC/mid who never wants prots.

items.name: Soul Reaver
items.simple: Ability hits deal extra damage based on the target’s health (base + item HP).
items.how: Tank shred for mages. Still goes through prots — buy pen too.
items.when: Fat tanks, Thebes stacks, Yogi’s bricks.
items.when_not: All glass enemies and you need pure burst/CDR sooner.

items.name: Spectral Armor
items.simple: You and nearby allies take less damage from critical hits.
items.how: Passive aura. Stand near your carry — they get part of the anti-crit too.
items.when: Enemy has a crit Carry (or anyone building crit). Default Support flex almost every game.
items.when_not: No crit threat at all (full ability damage lobby).

items.name: Spirit Robe
items.simple: When hard CC’d, you gain a big dual-prot buff and a small heal.
items.how: CC makes you tankier briefly. Note: enemies can ‘proc’ this on purpose.
items.when: Lots of hard CC and you’re frontline.
items.when_not: You want to avoid giving them free value; Magi’s is cleaner for ‘don’t get CC’d’.

items.name: Staff of Myrddin
items.simple: Active: your next non-ult ability has no cooldown.
items.how: Double-cast button. Huge on burst mages with a key spell.
items.when: Your combo is one ability twice (or reset a big CD).
items.when_not: Low impact abilities; you need pen/heal cut first.

items.name: Stampede
items.simple: Active: you and nearby allies get slow immunity and a huge decaying speed boost.
items.how: Engage or disengage button for the whole team.
items.when: You need team move for fights/rotates (classic support).
items.when_not: Rarely — it’s a standard support tool when speed wins fights.

items.name: Stygian Anchor
items.simple: Your damage cuts enemy healing (antiheal) and slows their attack speed in stacks.
items.how: Real anti-heal on ability damage (not Contagion). Also shreds AS.
items.when: Aphro, Yogi’s, Cu sustain, heavy lifesteal, heal comps.
items.when_not: Zero healing on the enemy team.
items.buy_as: Support/Solo whenever heals are real — don’t wait until item 6.

items.name: Titan's Bane
items.simple: % physical penetration + first ability cast bonus pen (Shattering).
items.how: Same idea as Obsidian for physical. Don’t skip into bulk.
items.when: Physical damage roles mid/late.
items.when_not: You only AA and never cast (still usually good).

items.name: Toxic Blade
items.simple: Your basics apply healing reduction and attack-speed slow.
